A '''snekfruit''' was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that tended to split open when overripe.<ref name="SoM" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]] compared the formation of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] splitting open to the overripe snekfruit in the [[Battle of the Corellian Queen|Battle of the ''Corellian Queen'']]<ref name="SoM" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A snekfruit was briefly mentioned in the first chapter of ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', a novel written by [[Matthew Stover]] in [[2008]].<ref name="SoM" />
